integrity.claim_kind: proved analytic idealization with exact supplementary checker
integrity.computational_scope: finite exact-rational checks for N up to 150; the infinite theorem does not rely on finite enumeration
integrity.proof_basis: divisor-query equivalence; mandatory adjacent prime powers; unique factorization; Farey gap
integrity.scientific_priority: best-knowledge comparison; not an assertion of global historical uniqueness

scientific_limitations: The result assumes all integer period aliases 1 through N remain viable, precise periodicity, deterministic transit responses, no scheduling constraints and equal-cost predetermined probes.
The common finite transit-window theorem assumes normalized half-width smaller than 1/(2N^2).
The exponential exact-grid resolution requirement does not hold for positive timing tolerance and is not an instrument specification.
Adaptive Bayesian campaigns, visibility windows, phase uncertainties and finite-sample field validation are outside scope.
title: Prime-power observation complexity and a cadence barrier for duotransit period aliases
